answer: A seat auction with burned bids keeps clones out. Each epoch opens a bridge of only 200 seats. Hopefuls post a sealed POA bid plus key hash, then reveal within 12 blocks; winners burn their bid to a dead address and losers burn 10 POA, no hand voting. Each key carries a quartz audit slip with bid, hash, and block for instant replay. A sybil verdict voids the cluster seats and burned coins stay dead. Taking 5,000 fake seats means sweeping 25 auctions, burning 500,000 POA plus 50,000 in fees over a shale-hard 25-epoch grind. It is fishing with dynamite where each stick sinks your boat.
